summary: The Maryland Department of Natural Resources reported a generally favorable response to the Environmental Impact Statement from all its member agencies. The Department requested to be kept informed of regulations as they are developed by the Bureaus of the Department of the Interior, noting that Maryland would be promulgating its own regulations for ORV use on lands under its control.

statement.text:
The review of this project in the Department of Natural Resources resulted in generally favorable response from all member agencies. The Department wishes to be kept informed of regulations as they are developed by the Bureaus of the Department of the Interior, since Maryland will be promulgating regulations for the use of Off-Road Vehicles to be applied within lands owned or under the control of the Department of Natural Resources.
Title Chief. Planning & Evaluation
Agency Dept. of Natural Resources
